title: Filter state diagram
description: The life of one thinking Filter while prompt feeds it generated text. Its state is the close marker of the thinking span it is inside (`close`): none means the text is answer, some means it is thinking until that marker. Two details ride along in every state: `held`, the end of the text that may begin a marker and waits for the next push, and `started`, which turns true with the first non-blank answer text and stops leading blank space from being shown. The spans are Qwen's `<think>`..`</think>`, Gemma 4's `<|channel>thought`..`<channel|>` and gpt-oss's `<|channel|>analysis<|message|>`..`<|end|>`; gpt-oss's `<|channel|>final<|message|>` and `<|start|>assistant` headers are dropped from the answer. prompt starts with Filter::new("") and replaces it with Filter::new(rendered prompt) when the engine reports Event::Prompt, before any text; finish is called once when generation ends, and the filter is then dropped.
machine: Filter (think.rs), driven by prompt in main.rs through push and finish

states.description: Filter::new is looking at the rendered prompt for a span the template opened and did not close.
Outside any span (close is None): text is shown as Piece::Answer, except a tail that may begin an open marker or a dropped header, which is held.
Inside a span (close is Some): text is Piece::Thought, except a tail that may begin the close marker, which is held.

transitions.guard: The prompt's last open marker of a span comes after that span's last close marker (a template that starts the thinking itself)
transitions.action: close is set to that span's close marker.

transitions.guard: No span is left open by the prompt
The earliest marker in the held and new text opens a span
transitions.action: The text before it becomes an Answer piece (leading blank space dropped until the answer starts); the rest is examined again inside the span.

transitions.guard: The earliest marker is a dropped gpt-oss header (preferred over an open marker at the same place)
transitions.action: The text before it becomes an Answer piece, the header is discarded, and the rest is examined again.
All but a tail that may begin a marker becomes an Answer piece; the tail is held.

transitions.guard: The text holds the span's close marker
transitions.action: The text before it becomes a Thought piece; close is cleared and the rest is examined again as answer.

transitions.guard: No close marker in the text
transitions.action: All but a tail that may begin the close marker becomes a Thought piece; the tail is held.
The held text is shown as answer (blank space dropped if the answer has not started).
Generation ended inside a span: the held text becomes a Thought piece.
